connectorMetaData.name: DICOMweb WADO-RS Retrieve
connectorMetaData.author: NextGen Healthcare
connectorMetaData.description: Retrieves DICOM instances from a remote DICOMweb server using WADO-RS (GET /studies, /series, /instances). Saves each instance as a .dcm file in a configurable output folder and returns a JSON array of saved file paths.
